To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the viscoelasticity of the tube wall is a key element in the description of the flow.

1) the wall visco-elasticity plays an important role on pulsated flow in arteries; 2) the wall viscoplasticity is a key factor to understand the blood flow in aneurysm and to predict the rupture of aneurysm; 3) the wall viscos-elasticity plays a major role on the blood flow in arteries; and 4) the wall viscolasticity plays an important on pulsated flow of blood in arteries.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the modelling and the simulation of the blood flow in the human body.
the modelling of blood flows in arteries.
the numerical and experimental investigation of the flow of a Newtonian fluid in a straight tube with a viscoelastic wall.
